newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bezeq gets $150 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Bezeq gets $150 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Bezeq Israel Telecom has raised $150 million from a consortium of international banks led by Sumitomo Bank and Credit Suisse, the telephone monopoly said in a statement on Monday.
The five-year loan at Libor plus 0.3 percent is without any guarantees.
The agreement with the consortium, which also includes Bank Hapoalim, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce and Kredietbank NV of Belgium, was signed over the weekend in London.

A senior official from Credit Suisse said that despite the current political situation, the consortium decided to go ahead with the loan because of the trust the international banking community has in Bezeq and its ability to pay back the loan.
Recent violence between Palestinians and Israelis that killed over 70 people has heightened tension in the Middle East.
"We view the loan as as a vote of confidence in Bezeq and Israel," Bezeq president Yitzhak Kaul said.
In March Bezeq signed an agreement for a similar loan at Libor plus 0.45 percent.
